verdict.rationale: Khoj offers a built-in chat assistant that can search files, run code, browse online, use voice, and support custom agents/personas, all accessible via web, desktop, Emacs, Obsidian, WhatsApp, etc. This is a core, well-documented capability with first-party docs and some independent corroboration (community mentions of chat/search usage). missing for 10: deeper independent hands-on validation of agentic task delegation (e.g., multi-step autonomous task completion) beyond chat/search/code execution.
